playbooks.name: Endpoint Anomaly Response
playbooks.description: Unknown process communicating with a suspicious external destination.
playbooks.recommended_action: Investigate the endpoint, isolate the affected host if the anomaly is confirmed, and continue monitoring.

playbooks.name: Brute Force Login Response
playbooks.description: Multiple failed authentication attempts detected from the same source.
playbooks.recommended_action: Rate-limit the source IP, monitor authentication activity, and investigate the affected account.

playbooks.name: Suspicious Login Response
playbooks.description: Login detected from an unusual location, device, or behavioral pattern.
playbooks.recommended_action: Verify the login, challenge the session with additional authentication, and monitor the account.

playbooks.name: Phishing Email Response
playbooks.description: Potential phishing email containing a suspicious link, attachment, or credential harvesting attempt.
playbooks.recommended_action: Quarantine the suspicious email, block the malicious indicators, and investigate affected users.

playbooks.name: Malware Detection Response
playbooks.description: Potential malicious executable or malware behavior detected on an endpoint.
playbooks.recommended_action: Quarantine the affected endpoint, isolate suspicious files, and begin incident investigation.

playbooks.name: Privilege Escalation Response
playbooks.description: Unexpected privilege elevation or suspicious administrative activity detected.
playbooks.recommended_action: Disable or restrict the affected account, revoke suspicious privileges, and investigate the activity.

playbooks.name: Data Exfiltration Response
playbooks.description: Unusual outbound data transfer detected to a suspicious external destination.
playbooks.recommended_action: Block the destination, restrict outbound traffic, isolate the affected endpoint, and investigate the incident.

playbooks.name: Command and Control Response
playbooks.description: Endpoint communication with a suspected command-and-control destination detected.
playbooks.recommended_action: Block the destination, isolate the affected endpoint, and begin incident response.

playbooks.name: Account Compromise Response
playbooks.description: Multiple indicators suggest that a user account may have been compromised.
playbooks.recommended_action: Temporarily disable the affected account, revoke active sessions, reset credentials, and investigate.

playbooks.name: Attack Chain Response
playbooks.description: Multiple related security events indicate a coordinated attack chain.
playbooks.recommended_action: Initiate coordinated incident response, isolate affected endpoints, block malicious indicators, and require human approval before containment.
